subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should maintainers refresh and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89238 as the remaining same-session admission fix, or replace it with a new focused branch?
rationale: The bug remains valid, but the remaining path overlaps session-state and fallback-delivery semantics already flagged in review, so the next step is an ownership and merge-risk choice rather than another automatic fix PR.

options.title: Refresh the candidate PR
options.body: Rebase or update the open candidate PR, fix the accepted-queue fallback/session-state concern, and use it as the canonical remaining fix.

options.title: Open a replacement branch
options.body: Close or park the candidate only after a narrower replacement preserves its useful admission behavior and current-main recovery guards.

options.title: Defer broader steering semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open but leave true pause/abort/resume soft-steer semantics to the separate feature request.

recommendation.title: Refresh the candidate PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or update the open candidate PR, fix the accepted-queue fallback/session-state concern, and use it as the canonical remaining fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged partial fix and documented the exact ordinary-message slice left for follow-up.
